start: ^I nearly went home instead of coming in. I just couldn't face sitting there by myself tonight.
^Sounds like being alone felt too much tonight. What happened?
^Sometimes getting out of the house can help.

c-2: ^Maybe. That's partly why I came here.

loss_reveal: ^My aunt died three days ago. She was basically a second mum to me.
^She meant a lot to you. What do you miss most about her?
^At least you still have the rest of your family around you.

c-0: ^Her calls. She used to call me every Sunday, even if we had nothing to talk about.
c-1: ^Thank you. I know people mean well when they say that.
c-2: ^I know... but it doesn't really make losing her hurt less.

unwanted_help: ^Everyone keeps telling me to stay positive or that she's in a better place. I know they're trying to help, but sometimes I just want to be sad without somebody trying to fix it.
^You don't need someone to fix it. You just want someone to hear you.
^Maybe you should tell your family you need some space.

c-0: ^Yes. Exactly. That's what I've been trying to say.
c-1: ^Maybe I should. I don't think they realise how overwhelmed I feel.

service_moment: ^I haven't really looked after myself today either. I barely ate, and I don't think I've had much to drink. I came in planning to order something, but now I'm not sure what I want.

b: ^Water actually sounds good. I probably need that.
^I thought I wanted alcohol when I came in, but I'm not so sure anymore.
^Actually... could we just keep talking for another minute?

evaluate_service: ^Give me another minute. I'm still deciding.
family_pressure: ^My mum is struggling too, so everyone keeps telling me I need to be strong for her. Sometimes it feels like I'm carrying her grief as well as mine.
^You're dealing with your own grief while feeling responsible for hers too. What do you need right now?
^Maybe your sister could support your mum tonight so you can take a break.
^That's a lot for one person to carry.

c-0: ^Honestly? I think I just need a break from pretending I'm okay.
c-1: ^She probably could. I've been trying to do everything myself.

self_judgement: ^I still feel guilty, though. Everyone else is grieving too. Part of me thinks I should be handling this better.
^It sounds like you're judging yourself for not grieving the way you think you should.
^Try not to dwell on it too much.

c-0: ^Yeah... I think I am putting most of that pressure on myself.
c-1: ^That's true. I suppose I'm expecting a lot from myself.

ending: ^I'm still sad. I know one conversation isn't going to change what happened, but talking about her tonight helped.
